items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: This time, I was playing with a band directed by Jacques Largeaud... In Morocco, I went in Tanger to give a concert. The band leader was Jacques Largeaud

ctx.x: The festival runs for a week, I would give a concert, but Lily and I would stay for the whole week. Many great artists would play there, also: Albert Nicholas, Benny Waters, Memphis Slim, The Golden Gate Quartet, Guy Lafitte, etc. The atmosphere was very exciting. Not only were there musicians and their families, but also people who came from everywhere as paying guests and would stay for the week. So there would always be somebody to talk with, drink with, make music with. In the day time, we would go out for a…

After Super-Besse, we went to Nice where we got a taste of spring, then in April, we went to Morocco to Meknes, Rabat and Casablanca. It had been very long time since my last trip there. This time, I was playing with a band directed by Jacques Largeaud, who played organ and piano. He was also a school teacher, and was very nice and interesting fellow and we had a swell time. A few weeks laterm I went back to Copenhagen to do a T.V.show with Teddy Wilson. The funny thing is that we flew in the same plane and did…

I went back to play at the Trois Mailletz. I had been angry for some time with Madame Calvé, but decided to forget the difference. Past was past, and it's nice sometimes to play in a club. Another club where I started to play was the Caveau de la Huchette, also situated in the Latin Quarter, which had been bought by Danny Doris, the vibraphonist with whom I had worked quite a few times. The atmosphere of the Huchette was more easier going than at the Trois Mailletz, where people came more to listen to music. In…
